CustomField.description: The Custom Teams Message this recipient rule belongs to. TeamsMessageService loads the active rules of a Teams message with it. A rule with both a Custom Email Alert and a Custom Teams Message serves both: the same people receive the email and the Teams message.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Teams message this recipient receives. Fill it together with Custom Email Alert so the same person receives the email and the Teams message, or alone for a Teams-only recipient.
CustomField.label: Custom Teams Message
